title: Future Institutions: RIP: Multilateralism Rise: protocol orgs
description:
I have spent fifteen years staring into dark things: how do large power structures work, try to coordinate, try to solve global problems - and built (inside the UN / UNICEF) some entities that were not supposed to exist: an innovation fund, a crypto fund (with EF), open-source software now run by governments, and Giga, which works to connect every school on earth. Each one assumed a big institution could host small, fast ones. Maybe instead it gives birth to a new ecology.

This talk is about what grows next. The shape I see: many small organisations, each custodian of one thing (a dataset, a protocol, a registry, a standard), none big enough to capture, coordinated by open protocols and on-chain settlement rather than a secretariat. And a different way of paying for them, which I call open-source financing.  We are building some of these "gazelles" (not a unicorn, but also not a frog) in Geneva and I believe they show a possible, positive future of global change.
